items.title: 68113_Barney Bigard oral history interview
items.q: I know Freddie Guy was on that date, Bubber Miley.

ctx.x: Uh-huh. "Bugle Call Rag," "Stack-o-Lee Blues," and "Sweet Mama".
I know Freddie Guy was on that date, Bubber Miley.
Yeah. Otto Hardwick, Harry Carney, Barney Bigard, L. M. -- who's L. M., this is all initials. -- Bubber Miley, Joe Nanton, Duke Ellington (inaudible), Freddie Guy, Wellman Braud, and Sonny Greer.
